title: SG-5.4.3 Add game/tests/preload.test.ts with mocked dependencies
summary: One unit test file covers preload dedup, unknown refs, fallback key and BootScene wiring
description: Context: planPreload and resolveTextureKey live in game/src/engine/planPreload.ts and BootScene (game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts) uses both. Separate tests exist (game/tests/planPreload.test.ts, resolveTextureKey.test.ts, frontend/tests/bootScene*.test.ts), but game/tests/preload.test.ts does not exist. Desired behavior: one file with every dependency mocked covering deduplication, the unknown-reference issue, the fallback key and BootScene using the planner and fallback. Why: SG-5.4.3 asks for exactly this file.
acceptance_criteria: Given game/tests/preload.test.ts, when `npx vitest run tests/preload.test.ts` runs in game/, then it passes
Given an asset referenced twice, when planned, then it is loaded once
Given a ref missing from the manifest, when planned, then it is reported unknown and not loaded
Given an unknown id, when resolved, then the fallback key is returned
Given BootScene.preload, when run with mocks, then only planned assets load and unknown refs warn

in_scope: game/vitest.config.ts alias so game tests can import BootScene
preserve: Existing planPreload, resolveTextureKey and bootScene tests

technical_constraints: Mock phaser, the content module, and the filesystem; no real Phaser or network
